text: {"observations":"The f0 estimates in voiced stretches sit mostly at 140-175 Hz (e.g. 174 Hz at 0 s gliding down to about 140 Hz by 1.8 s; 145-162 Hz at 2.4-2.8 s; 134-148 Hz at 8.2-8.6 s), though salience is low. A clear harmonic series confirms this: peaks at about 173, 351, 524, 700, 875 and 1048 Hz at 0-0.5 s, and 170, 345 and 467 Hz at 5.6-6.1 s. Energy is concentrated in the 125-500 Hz bands. A mean pitch near 150 Hz with dips to about 135-140 Hz is in the upper adult-male range. It is below the typical range for a woman (about 165-255 Hz) and well below a child's (250 Hz and above), which argues against B and A. A teenager (D) cannot be excluded on pitch alone, but an animated adult man (C) is the best fit.","answer":"C"}
